title: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host
question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host 'blaze8-12', list the instance UUID, display name, key name, the number of system metadata entries and total vCPUs (from those metadata rows), along with the minimum instance ID and average memory (MB) for that display name among non-deleted instances on 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata key 'image_image_type', compute the average vCPUs per metadata entry (total vCPUs divided by metadata entry count) rounded to 2 decimals, and only return rows where this average exceeds 0.75.

prediction.sql:
WITH base_instances AS (
  SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, i.id, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
),
metadata_counts AS (
  SELECT b.uuid, b.display_name, b.key_name,
         COUNT(msm.id) AS metadata_entry_count,
         SUM(b.vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM base_instances b
  JOIN instance_system_metadata msm ON b.uuid = msm.instance_uuid
  GROUP BY b.uuid, b.display_name, b.key_name
),
qualified_instances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.display_name, i.id, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata msm ON i.uuid = msm.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND msm.key = 'image_image_type'
),
display_name_stats AS (
  SELECT display_name, MIN(id) AS min_instance_id, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb
  FROM qualified_instances
  GROUP BY display_name
)
SELECT mc.uuid AS instance_uuid, mc.display_name, mc.key_name,
       mc.metadata_entry_count, mc.total_vcpus,
       dns.min_instance_id, dns.avg_memory_mb,
       ROUND(mc.total_vcpus / mc.metadata_entry_count, 2) AS avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry
FROM metadata_counts mc
JOIN display_name_stats dns ON mc.display_name = dns.display_name
WHERE ROUND(mc.total_vcpus / mc.metadata_entry_count, 2) > 0.75
ORDER BY mc.uuid

),

WITH base_instances AS (
  SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, i.id, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
),
metadata_counts AS (
  SELECT b.uuid, b.display_name, b.key_name,
         COUNT(msm.id) AS metadata_entry_count,
         SUM(b.vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM base_instances b
  JOIN instance_system_metadata msm ON b.uuid = msm.instance_uuid
  GROUP BY b.uuid, b.display_name, b.key_name
),
qualified_instances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.display_name, i.id, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata msm ON i.uuid = msm.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND msm.key = 'image_image_type'
),
display_name_stats AS (
  SELECT display_name, MIN(id) AS min_instance_id, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb
  FROM qualified_instances
  GROUP BY display_name
)
SELECT mc.uuid AS instance_uuid, mc.display_name, mc.key_name,
       mc.metadata_entry_count, mc.total_vcpus,
       dns.min_instance_id, dns.avg_memory_mb,
       ROUND(mc.total_vcpus / mc.metadata_entry_count, 2) AS avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry
FROM metadata_counts mc
JOIN display_name_stats dns ON mc.display_name = dns.display_name
WHERE ROUND(mc.total_vcpus / mc.metadata_entry_count, 2) > 0.75
ORDER BY mc.uuid

SELECT
  i.uuid,
  i.display_name,
  i.key_name,
  COUNT(m.id) AS metadata_entry_count,
  SUM(CAST(m.value AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS total_vcpus,
  MIN(d.id) AS min_instance_id,
  AVG(d.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(m.value AS DECIMAL(10,2))) / COUNT(m.id), 2) AS avg_vcpus_per_entry
FROM instances i
JOIN instance_system_metadata m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
JOIN instances d
  ON d.display_name = i.display_name
 AND d.host = 'blaze8-12'
 AND d.deleted = 0
 AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1
   FROM instance_system_metadata dm
   WHERE dm.instance_uuid = d.uuid
     AND dm.`key` = 'image_image_type'
 )
WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name
HAVING ROUND(SUM(CAST(m.value AS DECIMAL(10,2))) / COUNT(m.id), 2) > 0.75;
